instructions: The same protocol, addendum, phase gold, and review instructions used for v4/v5 remain in force. Each new response is reviewed independently with variant identity hidden.
batching: Primary v6 review jobs follow the original generation batch membership: four to six answers per reviewer job. The initial v4/v5 review jobs contained both anonymous answers per case, so their workload was eight to twelve answers. This difference is disclosed; comparisons remain descriptive.
second_review: Audit the first passing original case in each hard split, all new failures/disputes, and B22 specifically because it motivated the revision. Do not replace a primary judgment silently.
scope: All v6 cases are retrospective. No new unique prompts or unseen status are created by rerunning them.
